name: AUTH-01 首次启动静默登录（mock wx.login + mock 后端）

setup.code: const c = globalThis.__cloudMock; if (!c) throw new Error('cloud-mock 未注入'); c.reset(); c.setScenario({ login: { responses: [{ status: 200, body: () => ({ accessToken: c.issueToken({ ttlMs: 3600e3 }), expiresIn: 3600, refreshToken: 'e2e-refresh-1', refreshExpiresIn: 2592000, user: { id: '1', nickname: 'E2E', avatarUrl: null } }) }] } }); wx.clearStorageSync(); return { cleared: true, hasBle: !!globalThis.__bleMock };

steps.code: const app = getApp(); const c = globalThis.__cloudMock; app.silentLogin(); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn()) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return { loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), counts: c.getState().counts };

assertions.code: const app = getApp(); const raw = wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession'); let session = null; try { session = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; } catch (e) { session = null; } const reqs = globalThis.__cloudMock.getRequests().filter((r) => r.route === 'login'); return { hasSession: !!session, refreshToken: session ? session.refreshToken : null, loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), usable: app.cloudAuth.hasUsableAccess(), hasSync: !!app.cloudSync, hasApi: !!app.cloudApi, localOnly: app.cloudSync ? app.cloudSync.isLocalOnly() : null, sawFakeCode: reqs.some((r) => r.requestBody && r.requestBody.code === 'e2e-fake-code') };
